observed_bad_cases.description: The model used the scores table even though schema links only referenced students, causing duplicate rows.
The model generated s.score_id although alias s referred to students; SQLite reported no such column.

interpretation: This is a small handcrafted feasibility test, not an official Spider or BIRD benchmark and not a training result.
next_step: Add static schema-link validation and execution-error-driven SQL revision, then evaluate the revised workflow.
